name: Nobah's species
description: A sentient species existed in the galaxy. These aliens were near-human humanoids distinguished by their flat, wide noses with a scale-like texture, as well as a pointed nasion. One member of this species, Nobah, served as prefect of a community on an ice planet who paid tribute to the Neo-Imperial warlord Barro for protection during or after 11 ABY.
